---
applyTo: "docs/plans/**, PLAN-*.md"
---

# Writing Plans (sdlc-lean)

Break approved work into 3–7 prioritized tasks, one verifiable outcome each. One plan per feature.

Task table columns: # | Task | Spec req | Files | Test | Expected | Verify.
- Verify is an external command (test/lint/CLI), never "reviewed it".
- Files = exact edit scope; never plan edits to the tests that grade the work.
- Never self-approve: status draft, approved_by/approved_at empty.
